parsed.name: SocketCAN总线接口
parsed.description: 基于 Linux SocketCAN 的 CAN 总线软件通信接口，用于在实验系统中发送 CAN 报文、管理周期发送任务并关闭总线套接字连接。它本身不是物理仪器，而是用于连接和控制 CAN 网络设备的非实体组件。
parsed.description_en: A Linux SocketCAN-based software communication interface for CAN bus messaging, periodic transmission task management, and socket shutdown in laboratory systems. It is not a physical instrument, but a non-physical component used to connect to and control devices on a CAN network.

actions.description: 关闭 SocketCAN 总线接口，停止所有活动的周期发送任务并关闭套接字。
actions.description_en: Shut down the SocketCAN bus interface by stopping all active periodic send tasks and closing the socket.

actions.description: 向 CAN 总线发送一条报文，并可在设定超时时间内等待发送队列可用。
actions.description_en: Send a message onto the CAN bus, optionally waiting up to a timeout for the transmit queue to become available.

actions.description: 获取该 SocketCAN 接口底层套接字的文件描述符。
actions.description_en: Get the file descriptor of the underlying socket used by this SocketCAN interface.
